senses.sense_definition: The small, round, edible fruit of the longan tree, having a thin brown shell and sweet, translucent white flesh.

examples.text: She peeled the thin skin of the <w>longan</w> to reveal the sweet, translucent fruit inside.
We bought a basket of <w>fresh</w> <w>longan</w> at the local Asian market.

senses.sense_definition: An evergreen tree, Dimocarpus longan, native to southern China and Southeast Asia, which produces the longan fruit.

examples.text: The farmer planted a young <w>longan</w> in his orchard, hoping it would bear fruit in a few years.
In southern China, you can find many orchards dedicated to growing the <w>longan</w> tree.
